summary_en: CE Holdings to conduct self-tender offer for treasury shares following planned delisting by SK-03 fund-backed acquisition group. Size and price ceiling not yet disclosed in board resolution. Execution contingent on third-party tender offer completion and extraordinary shareholder approval of share consolidation. Open-market or ToSTNeT-3 method. Purpose: fund consolidation post-MBO squeeze-out.
title_en: Notice regarding planned initiation of public tender offer for own shares
translation_en_brief: CE Holdings announced on 5 August 2026 that its board resolved to conduct a public tender offer for its own shares, contingent on completion of a third-party tender offer by SK-03-sponsored acquisition vehicle. The transaction is structured as a take-private delisting of CE Holdings from Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard market and Sapporo Exchange. The filer's self-tender will follow a parallel acquisition of founder CEO Shigenobu Sugimoto's 1,450,800-share stake (8.70% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) from the third-party tender proceeds. Share consolidation and elimination of share unit rules will be approved at an extraordinary shareholder meeting before the self-tender is formally authorized post-MBO. Specific share count, yen ceiling, and execution timeline for the self-tender are deferred pending completion of the third-party tender and shareholder approval; these details will be announced formally after those conditions are satisfied. The self-tender will be conducted to secure capital for the consolidated entity post-squeeze-out.
